import ctypes as C,json,math,sys,collections
lib=C.CDLL(sys.argv[1])
class E(C.Structure):_fields_=[('x',C.c_float),('z',C.c_float),('hp',C.c_uint),('side',C.c_uint),('kind',C.c_uint),('front',C.c_uint),('target',C.c_int),('generation',C.c_uint)]
class A(C.Structure):_fields_=[(n,C.c_float)for n in('y','heading','pitch','bank','speed')]+[(n,C.c_uint)for n in('role','mode')]+[('target',C.c_int)]+[(n,C.c_uint)for n in('cooldown','ammo','generation')]+[(n,C.c_float)for n in('vx','vy','vz')]+[(n,C.c_uint)for n in('pass_ticks','flags')]
class P(C.Structure):_fields_=[(n,C.c_float)for n in('x','y','z','vx','vy','vz')]+[(n,C.c_uint)for n in('ttl','side','kind','damage')]+[('radius',C.c_float)]+[(n,C.c_uint)for n in('source','generation','active','source_generation','reserved')]
e=(E*32768).in_dll(lib,'sim_entities');a=(A*32768).in_dll(lib,'sim_aircraft');p=(P*512).in_dll(lib,'sim_projectiles');seen=set();miss=[];unmatched=0
assert lib.sim_init(8192,42)==0
for tick in range(1,901):
 lib.sim_tick()
 for slot,s in enumerate(p):
  if not s.active or s.kind!=4 or (slot,s.generation)in seen:continue
  seen.add((slot,s.generation));target=a[s.source].target
  if not 0<=target<8192:unmatched+=1;continue
  # Recover launch origin from one physical tick of projectile travel.
  r=(e[target].x-(s.x-s.vx),a[target].y-(s.y-s.vy),e[target].z-(s.z-s.vz));w=(s.vx-a[target].vx,s.vy-a[target].vy,s.vz-a[target].vz)
  time=sum(x*y for x,y in zip(r,w))/sum(x*x for x in w)
  miss.append(math.sqrt(sum((x-y*time)**2 for x,y in zip(r,w))))
miss.sort();print(json.dumps({'births':len(seen),'matched_target_births':len(miss),'unmatched':unmatched,'predicted_miss_p50_m':miss[len(miss)//2],'predicted_miss_p90_m':miss[int(len(miss)*.9)],'predicted_within_4m':sum(m<=4 for m in miss),'remaining_rounds':sum(a[i].ammo for i in range(8192)if e[i].kind==3 and a[i].role==1)}))
